description: Checks whether a domain publishes an llms.txt file and whether it follows the llmstxt.org specification: H1 title, optional blockquote summary, '## Section' headings, and Markdown link list items ('- [Title](URL): notes'). Returns existence, a 0-100 compliance score, and the extracted links.

domain.description: Domain or base URL, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

name: check_llms_txt
